Bug_Title: UwF: Field only ever set to null (UWF_NULL_FIELD)
Bug_Details:
All writes to this field are of the constant value null, and thus
all reads of the field will return null.
Check for errors, or remove it if it is useless.
Bug_Explanation: The field 'alwaysNull' is only ever assigned the constant value 'null'. This means that any read operations on this field will always result in the value 'null'. This is a demonstration of the UWF_NULL_FIELD bug as the field is effectively useless unless explicitly set to a non-null value elsewhere, which never happens in this code.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which returns the value of the alwaysNull field. Since alwaysNull is only ever set to null, the test case fails when it asserts that the value should not be null.
